title: PACK-15 assertion queue event payload (v1)
description: Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.voting_trust_events.build_queue_event. Used by eligibility_assertion.queued, the one assertion-stream type whose payload reports the release batch and the cohort it was released with. It deliberately omits every exact size - cohort size, batch size and queue depth are never published, only the class in cohort_size_class (epd2_eligibility_service.voting_timing.CohortSizeClass), because an exact cohort size in a small electorate is itself a participation statement (T-P15-37).
